text:
Morgan: quick scrub ran on `handbook/serving` — found ~12 orphan anchors and 3 staging-403 images. pushed a small branch with all diffs: https://github.com/redwood/docs/compare/mini-scrub-171678 (split commits per file). can owners please claim what they'll review?

Kai: can you paste the 3 image paths here? I'll take those if they're legit staging 403s. :+1:

Morgan: sure — images are:
- /assets/serving/runtime/arch-diagram.png (staging 403)
- /assets/serving/cache/kv-cache.png (staging 403)
- /assets/handbook/ops/oncall-flow.png (staging 403)

Lina: I'll claim the orphan anchors in runtime and cache pages. sending a quick PR review later today. PTAL @Morgan for the branch split.

Morgan: awesome — I split into three small PRs to keep CI light: `mini-scrub/anchors-runtime`, `mini-scrub/anchors-cache`, `mini-scrub/staging-images`. small sed used:
```bash
rg 'href=.*#' handbook/serving -n | sed 's/:.*//' | sort -u
```
that produced the candidate pages.

Kai: thanks — for the images, staging is serving them via the preview CDN. I'll open a tiny rehost PR to blobstore and swap the links. ETA EOD.

Lina: one note — I saw one anchor that looks intentionally removed (old API param section). I'll add a redirect anchor and comment in the PR rather than delete.

Morgan: good call. if anyone wants me to split more tiny PRs to speed merges lmk.

Kai: assigning @Lina as reviewer on anchors-runtime and @Morgan on staging-images. I'll request review from docs-ops for the image rehost.

docs-bot: scan completed: 12 orphan anchors found, 3 image 403s, 0 broken external links. Patch branch created: mini-scrub-171678. CI queued for PRs.

Morgan: one logistics ask — can reviewers keep to tiny comments only (typos / anchor name clarifications) so these can merge before next deploy? we want to avoid a blocked ship.

Lina: yep — quick approvals on my end barring content regressions. I'll call out any places where text needs slight rewording.

Kai: will do. thanks all :)
